name: centry-crypto-records
description:
Combine supplied wallet and exchange CSVs into a traceable ledger, flag duplicates and candidate transfers, identify missing acquisition history, and prepare disposal, source-of-funds and family-handover packs. No transactions, tax determination or bank acceptance guarantee.

Work through supplied facts in the conversation or optional interactive workspace. Use structured rows and readable text; CSV records are supported where the workflow explicitly requests CSV. Complex PDFs, images and scanned records need verified transcription. Export a plain-text pack for your own review.

Candidate matches require review. No tax or cost-basis determination, wallet connection, certification or bank-acceptance guarantee; never collect signing secrets. No exchange, wallet, blockchain or bank connection; text/CSV evidence is supplied and unauthenticated. No tax calculation, cost-basis election, holding-period tax classification or source-of-funds certification. Duplicate and transfer matches are candidates for human review, not independently verified facts. Fiat amounts retain supplied currency. Legacy fiatEUR/feeEUR is explicitly EUR. Crypto-denominated fees need separate quantity outflow records; no fiat totals are combined. No secrets, signing, transfers or guaranteed bank acceptance.

Use fictional examples or redacted records; do not provide passwords, signing secrets, account numbers or government identifiers. No account connection or financial execution is included. Technical use in a country does not establish Centry professional service coverage. Centry does not provide US tax advice. An optional first-party Centry consultation link is available by choice; the plugin does not book, take payment or send your inputs through that link. Operated by Centry Cognitive Capital Pte. Ltd., Singapore (UEN 202514224H).

Quantities support up to eight decimal places, with each record and running balance limited to 67,108,863.99999999 units in magnitude. Higher precision or quantities require separate specialist reconciliation and are rejected explicitly. Use either the legacy EUR columns or international monetary columns, not both. Transfer candidates must be unique in both directions.

publication.release_notes: Initial 1.0.0 release of Centry Crypto Records: Combine supplied wallet and exchange CSVs into a traceable ledger, flag duplicates and candidate transfers, identify missing acquisition history, and prepare disposal, source-of-funds and family-handover packs. No transactions, tax determination or bank acceptance guarantee. Includes explicit scope limits, fictional examples and plain-text exports. Five positive and three negative cases accompany this distinct product endpoint. No account or payment is required for the planning utility.
